tasks.design: The engineer writes, reviews, or maintains engineering documentation. The engineer writes the text and reviews it, both at full effort. {DOCS} stores only the accepted documentation, with the revision the engineer set. A blank revision is not stored. The text is not generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer wrote the document and then retyped the revision record.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted document can be stored with the revision the engineer already set.
tasks.still_hard: Writing what the design means stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not store a document whose revision or title is blank.
tasks.altitude: The record is written only after the engineer accepts that version. The wording stays theirs.

reach.task: Confirm the document matches the released design

evidence.claim: An accepted engineering document can be stored with its revision. Writing and reviewing the text stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a design that needs documentation and ends when the accepted document is stored or the engineer stops.
The draft has title, revision, and text, written by the engineer. A blank revision is left blank and is not stored.
The store uses the documentation accepted in the review. A later edit voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which documents must carry a signed revision.
research_questions: How often did a blank revision stop the store?

already_counted.description: Writing the engineering documentation is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a revision or a title before the document is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the text is still written by hand, so storing the record is part of the task only. High: the text is written and reviewed, and only the accepted documentation is stored. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop specifications for vehicles powered by alternative fuels
Develop specifications for alternative power methods

tasks.design: The engineer develops specifications for vehicles powered by alternative fuels or alternative power methods. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The specification stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer writes the specification from the power choice.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the specification stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not specify a method the vehicle cannot use.
tasks.altitude: The specification stays the engineer's. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Choose the fuel or the power method
reach.learn: Which methods the lead has ruled out.

evidence.claim: Developing specifications for alternative fuels or alternative power methods stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a fuel or a power method and ends when the engineer has specified it, or stops.
No new record is filed by a system. Upkeep is zero.
A released specification document is a different task.
unknowns: Which alternative fuels are in scope.
research_questions: Which methods did the engineer refuse to specify?

already_counted.description: Developing specifications for alternative-fuel vehicles is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the specification adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every specification is still written by the engineer. High: the same specification work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Build models for algorithm verification testing
Build models for control feature verification

tasks.design: The engineer builds models for algorithm or control feature verification testing. Nothing is generated in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Building the model stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer builds the model and uses it to verify.
tasks.enabler_now: No generated model replaces the one the engineer builds.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the model and reading what it shows stay with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not trust a model that cannot be tied to the algorithm or the feature.
tasks.altitude: Building the model stays the engineer's. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Provide the algorithm or the feature to model
reach.learn: Which features are not ready to model.

evidence.claim: Building models for algorithm or control-feature verification stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with an algorithm or a control feature and ends when the engineer has built the model, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
The verification test on the vehicle is a different task.
unknowns: Which features must be verified on the vehicle as well as in the model.
research_questions: Which models did the engineer abandon because they did not match the feature?

already_counted.description: Building models for algorithm verification testing is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: building the model adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every model is still built by the engineer. High: the same model-building remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

steps.what: Coordinate production activities with other functional units
Coordinate with procurement, maintenance, or quality control

tasks.design: The engineer coordinates production activities with other functional units, such as procurement, maintenance, or quality control. Nothing is sent by {EMAIL}. The coordination stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer talks with the other units and aligns the work.
tasks.still_hard: Aligning the units stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not record an agreement the other unit has not given.
tasks.altitude: Coordination stays the conversation. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Confirm the unit can meet the plan
reach.learn: Which activities that unit cannot take.

evidence.claim: Coordinating production with procurement, maintenance, or quality control stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a production plan to align and ends when the engineer has coordinated the units, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A purchase or a maintenance order, if one follows, is a different task.
unknowns: Which units must agree before production changes.
research_questions: Which activities stayed unaligned after the last coordination?

already_counted.description: Coordinating production activities is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the coordination adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every alignment is still done in conversation. High: the same coordination remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
